Summary: Project setup and governance
Description: Repository, group agreement and shared conventions so everyone can work without collisions.
Acceptance Criteria: All members can clone the repo and run the site locally.

Summary: Site shell and shared styles
Description: Shared header, navigation, footer and the external stylesheet used by all four pages.
Acceptance Criteria: All four pages share one identical header and footer, and link one stylesheet.

Summary: Home page
Description: index.html with company identity, merged-cell table, search prototype and the inclusion statement.
Acceptance Criteria: index.html validates and meets every Home requirement in the brief.

Summary: Jobs page
Description: jobs.html with at least two full vacancies and the floated aside.
Acceptance Criteria: jobs.html validates and the aside floats right at 25% on desktop.

Summary: Apply page
Description: apply.html with the full validated application form.
Acceptance Criteria: All 13 fields present with correct validation, and the POST reaches the test script.

Summary: About page
Description: about.html with team details, quotes, group photo and fun facts.
Acceptance Criteria: about.html validates and contains no placeholders.

Summary: Accessibility and quality
Description: Validation, responsive behaviour, keyboard access and contrast across the site.
Acceptance Criteria: All pages validate with zero errors and pass the keyboard walkthrough.

Summary: Deployment and submission
Description: GitHub Pages deployment and the Canvas submission package.
Acceptance Criteria: Live site reachable, and the ZIP matches the deployed code.

Summary: As a group we need a shared repository so we can work in parallel
Description: Create the GitHub repo, add all members, agree a branch naming convention.
Acceptance Criteria: Every member has pushed at least one commit.

Summary: As a group we must submit the Group Agreement before starting work
Description: Complete and sign the template, then upload it individually on Canvas.
Acceptance Criteria: Agreement submitted by every member before any project commit.

Summary: Confirm the allocated group code and industry with the tutor
Description: Blocks all content writing. Record the answer in decisions.md D-01.
Acceptance Criteria: Group code recorded and content re-tailored to that industry.

Summary: Confirm the real due date with the tutor
Description: The brief and Canvas disagree. Record the answer in decisions.md D-02.
Acceptance Criteria: One agreed date written into the release checklist.

Summary: As a visitor I need the same navigation on every page so I never get lost
Description: Build the shared header and nav with the current page marked.
Acceptance Criteria: All four pages have identical nav markup with aria-current on the current page.

Summary: As a visitor I need a footer with the project links
Description: Jira, GitHub, live site and email in the footer of every page.
Acceptance Criteria: Four footer items present on all pages.

Summary: Create the external stylesheet with the required comment header
Description: Set up styles.css with the unit comment block and numbered section banners.
Acceptance Criteria: styles.css validates with zero errors.

Summary: Define the colour palette and check contrast
Description: Choose hex colours and verify every text pair meets at least 4.5 to 1.
Acceptance Criteria: All measured ratios recorded in the test report.

Summary: As a jobseeker I want to see who the company is so I can decide whether to apply
Description: Logo, name, slogan, description and image on the home page.
Acceptance Criteria: All five identity elements present.

Summary: As a jobseeker I want to understand the hiring process before I apply
Description: Build the merged-cell process table with a caption and scoped headers.
Acceptance Criteria: Table uses both rowspan and colspan and validates.

Summary: As a jobseeker I want to search for a role
Description: Labelled search field and button that navigates to the vacancy list.
Acceptance Criteria: Search box and button present, with a visible note on what it does not do.

Summary: Add the CSS background graphic to the home page
Description: Local SVG pattern applied with background-image without harming contrast.
Acceptance Criteria: background-image rule present and the asset loads.

Summary: Write the inclusion statement and explain its relevance
Description: Inclusive employment statement plus reconciliation commitment, with explanation.
Acceptance Criteria: Statement present and clearly explained, with nothing invented.

Summary: As a jobseeker I need full vacancy details so I can judge my fit
Description: Two complete job descriptions with all seven required fields each.
Acceptance Criteria: Both vacancies carry a five character reference, salary, reporting line, responsibilities and both requirement groups.

Summary: Build the floated aside and its responsive override
Description: Float right at 25% with margin, padding and border on desktop only.
Acceptance Criteria: Measured at 25% with float right on desktop, and float none on mobile.

Summary: Add the ordered and unordered lists required by the brief
Description: Ordered list for the application steps, unordered lists for requirements.
Acceptance Criteria: At least one ol and one ul present.

Summary: As an applicant I want to apply online without confusion
Description: Build all 13 form fields with visible labels and format hints.
Acceptance Criteria: Every field has a label and the correct input type.

Summary: Implement HTML5 validation patterns for every constrained field
Description: Reference, names, date of birth, postcode, phone and email.
Acceptance Criteria: All boundary cases in the test plan behave as expected.

Summary: Lay out the form with CSS Grid
Description: One column on mobile, two columns from the medium breakpoint.
Acceptance Criteria: display grid confirmed, with the correct column count at each width.

Summary: Resolve the skills checkbox ambiguity with the tutor
Description: Decide between all-required and at-least-one. See decisions.md D-04.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision recorded and implemented.

Summary: Verify the POST endpoint with synthetic data only
Description: Submit made-up test data and confirm every field arrives intact.
Acceptance Criteria: Server echo shows all fields, including leading zeros.

Summary: As a marker I want to see who built what
Description: Nested list for class details and a definition list for contributions.
Acceptance Criteria: Nested list and definition list present and populated.

Summary: As a team member I want my quote shown in my own language
Description: Collect one quote plus an English translation from each member.
Acceptance Criteria: Every member has a quote with a lang attribute and a translation.

Summary: Take and optimise the group photo
Description: One photo of the whole group, under 300KB, inside a bordered figure.
Acceptance Criteria: File exists, is under 300KB, and sits inside a figure with a caption.

Summary: Build the fun facts table with hex colours and hover
Description: Caption, hexadecimal colours and a hover effect that hides nothing.
Acceptance Criteria: Table renders with hover and stays readable without it.

Summary: Style the student IDs
Description: Distinct styling for every student ID on the about page.
Acceptance Criteria: IDs are visibly distinct from body text.

Summary: Validate every page and fix all errors
Description: Run the HTML and CSS validators and fix everything reported.
Acceptance Criteria: Zero errors on all four pages and the stylesheet.

Summary: Test the site at 320 375 768 1024 and 1440 pixels
Description: Check for horizontal overflow and broken layout at each width.
Acceptance Criteria: No page scrolls sideways at any tested width.

Summary: Keyboard and focus walkthrough
Description: Tab through every page and confirm focus is always visible.
Acceptance Criteria: Skip link works and the focus ring is visible on every control.

Summary: Review the site against the Accessibility Guideline PDF
Description: Download the guideline from Canvas and re-check all four pages.
Acceptance Criteria: Review completed and findings recorded.

Summary: Deploy to GitHub Pages and verify the live site
Description: Enable Pages, then retest links and layout on the deployed URL.
Acceptance Criteria: Live URL loads with all assets and working navigation.

Summary: Add the real Jira GitHub and Pages URLs to the footer
Description: Replace the three pending markers on all four pages.
Acceptance Criteria: No pending markers remain in any page.

Summary: Build the ZIP and submit on Canvas
Description: Package the site and docs, and confirm the ZIP matches the deployed code.
Acceptance Criteria: ZIP submitted, with the live URL included in the comment.
